description: The same twelve 2/0 E-AC-3 frames with other seeds and a random blend in every set of coordinates, so that the extension blends in noise (A/52 Annex E 3.6.4.2).

skip.skip_insertion: The check rewrites E-AC-3 frames with skip fields.
skip.decode: The noise of spectral extension comes from a generator of each decoder, so the samples differ; the level of the noise equals FFmpeg's (docs/development.md, "E-AC-3 decoding").
